# 2.3.2 Three Flashes (Level AAA)

- Principle: 2 Operable
- Guideline: 2.3 Seizures and Physical Reactions
- Level: AAA
- Versions: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2
- Understanding: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/three-flashes.html
- Specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#three-flashes

## Normative text

[Web pages](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-web-page-s) do not contain anything that [flashes](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/#dfn-flashes) more than three times in any one second period.

## Sufficient techniques

- G19: Ensuring that no component of the content flashes more than three times in any 1-second period
